license_required.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or attempt or offer to practice either within the State of Arkansas without first having been authorized and issued a regular license by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners.

issuing_authority.value: Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners
issuing_authority.quote: issued a regular license by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners

name.value: Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners
name.quote: issued a regular license by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners

type.quote: The Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners has exclusive jurisdiction to determine who shall be permitted to practice dentistry and dental hygiene in the State of Arkansas.

age_minimum.quote: Be at least twenty-one (21) years of age

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant must be of good moral reputation and character

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Surgery or Doctor of Dental Medicine
degree_required.quote: Have graduated from an American Dental Association-accredited college of dentistry with the degree of Doctor of Dental Surgery or Doctor of Dental Medicine

accrediting_body.quote: graduated from an American Dental Association-accredited college of dentistry

required.quote: Serve a period of at least one (1) year under a provisional license issued by the board to foreign graduates

duration.quote: Serve a period of at least one (1) year under a provisional license issued by the board to foreign graduates

kind.quote: Serve a period of at least one (1) year under a provisional license issued by the board to foreign graduates and successfully complete the monitoring requirements as ordered by the board

exams.name: Arkansas State Board Dental Examination (written and clinical)
exams.notes: Board conducts at least two examinations annually; may accept National Board Dental Examinations
exams.quote: shall conduct examinations, both written and clinical, of all qualified applicants who desire to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in the State of Arkansas

exams.name: National Board Dental Examinations
exams.notes: Board may accept results in lieu of its own written examination
exams.quote: The Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners may accept the results of the National Board Dental Examinations if it so desires

interval_years.quote: On January 1 of even-numbered years, every dentist and dental hygienist must renew his or her license with the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners

required.quote: The regulatory boards of the professions or occupations classified by the laws of the State of Arkansas as professions of the healing arts ... are authorized to adopt rules requiring the continuing education of the persons licensed by the board.

available.quote: A dentist or dental hygienist who desires to practice his or her profession in the State of Arkansas and who has been practicing his or her profession continuously for a period of five (5) years or more ... may apply in writing to the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners for a license to practice his or her profession in the State of Arkansas without undergoing the examination required for licensing

requirements.value: Must have practiced continuously for 5+ years under a license from another state, territory, DC, or Canada where the standard of proficiency at least equals that of Arkansas; must submit original or certified copy of prior license and proof of fitness.
requirements.quote: The applicant must have been practicing by virtue of a license lawfully issued by the authority of another state, territory, the District of Columbia, or Canada, where the standard of proficiency at least equals that of the State of Arkansas.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or attempt or offer to practice either within the State of Arkansas without first having been authorized and issued a regular license by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners.

credential_type.quote: it shall issue to him or her without further initial cost a license to practice dentistry in the State of Arkansas

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice dentistry or dental hygiene or attempt or offer to practice either within the State of Arkansas without first having been authorized and issued a regular license by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners.

title_protection.quote: A licensed dentist shall not hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist or publicly announce as being specifically qualified in any particular branch of dentistry ... until he or she has been issued a certificate by the board authorizing him or her to do so.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who violates any provision of subsection (a) of this section shall be guilty of a Class D felony and shall be subject to imprisonment not to exceed six (6) years in the Division of Correction or a fine of up to ten thousand dollars ($10,000), or both.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting or filing a fraudulently or illegally obtained diploma, license, or certificate to secure a license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The presentation to or filing with the board, for the purpose of securing a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene or to obtain any permit issued by the board, of any diploma, license, or certificate illegally or fraudulently obtained by the applicant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using an assumed or fictitious name in applying for a license to shield moral unfitness or a criminal record
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of an assumed or fictitious name in applying for a license for the purpose of shielding moral unfitness or a criminal record

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of criminal operations, habitual drunkenness, insanity, felony conviction, narcotics addiction, immoral conduct, professional incompetency, failure to maintain sanitation standards, or use of dangerous unknown anesthetics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any criminal operation; habitual drunkenness for a period of three (3) months; insanity; adjudication of insanity or mental incompetency if deemed detrimental to patients; conviction of a felony listed under § 17-3-102; addiction to narcotics; immoral, dishonorable, or scandalous conduct; professional incompetency; failure to maintain proper standards of sanitation or failure otherwise to maintain adequate safeguards for the health and safety of patients; or employment in the practice of the profession of any drug, nostrum, unknown formula, or dangerous or unknown anesthetic not generally used by the dental profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising services to the public in a fraudulent or misleading manner or in violation of board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising of services to the public which is fraudulent and misleading or which does not comply with the rules of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting an unlicensed person to perform acts constituting the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene or involving administration of drugs or anesthetics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The permitting of any unlicensed person under his or her supervision or control to perform any act, service, practice, or operation on any patient or prospective patient which constitutes a part of the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene or is involved with the administration of drugs, medicines, or anesthetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any board rule governing standards of professional conduct for dentists and dental hygienists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any rule of board standards of professional conduct for dentists and dental hygienists practicing within the state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any term of probation or prior board order affecting the licensee or permit holder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any term of probation or order previously entered by the board affecting the licensee or permit holder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found in violation of a statute or rule governing dentistry or dental hygiene by a dental licensing authority of another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found in violation of a statute or a rule governing the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene by the dental licensing authority or agency or another state.

definition_quote.value: The evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment by nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body
definition_quote.quote: The evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment by nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area, and the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body

methods_authorized.quote: treatment by nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures ... shall include, but not be limited to, the administration of anesthetics

drug_authority.value: Pharmacists duly licensed in Arkansas are authorized to fill prescriptions for duly licensed dentists for any drug to be used in the practice of dentistry; board shall promulgate rules limiting Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed.
drug_authority.quote: Pharmacists duly licensed in the State of Arkansas are authorized to fill prescriptions in the State of Arkansas for duly licensed dentists of this state for any drug to be used in the practice of dentistry.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: Any dentist who desires to administer to a patient general anesthesia or sedation as defined by the rules of the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners and the State of Arkansas shall apply in writing for a permit from the board

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: shall apply in writing for a permit from the board, shall submit to an on-site inspection by the board, as defined and described in the rules of the board

specialist_license_available.quote: A dentist in this state licensed by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners who has complied with requirements as specified by the Council on Dental Education and Licensure of the American Dental Association in a specialty branch of dentistry ... may apply for a certificate as a specialist.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: The issuance of a specialist license does not limit a licensed dentist's ability to practice in any other area of dentistry for which the dentist is qualified, including general dentistry.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: All dental hygienist acts, services, and practices shall be performed under the supervision of a licensed dentist with the supervision being defined in regulations of the board.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: "Collaborative agreement" means a written agreement between a dentist licensed by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners and a dental hygienist licensed by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners providing that the dental hygienist may provide prophylaxis, fluoride treatments, sealants, dental hygiene instruction, assessment of a patient's need for further treatment by a dentist, and if delegated by the consulting dentist, other services provided by law to children, senior citizens, and persons with developmental disabilities in a public setting without the supervision and presence of the dentist

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: has entered into a collaborative agreement with no more than three (3) collaborative dental hygienists regarding the provision of services under this subchapter

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist licensed by the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners is eligible for a Collaborative Care Permit I if the dental hygienist has: Practiced as a dental hygienist for one thousand two hundred (1,200) clinical hours

advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A collaborative dental hygienist who holds a Collaborative Care Permit II may provide prophylaxis, fluoride treatments, sealants, dental hygiene instruction, assessment of the patient's need for further treatment by a dentist, and other services provided by law if delegated by the consulting dentist to children, senior citizens, and persons with developmental disabilities in public settings

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: Before an operator operates a mobile dental facility, the Arkansas State Board of Dental Examiners shall issue a permit to the operator to operate a mobile dental facility.

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: An operator shall maintain a written procedure for emergency follow-up care for patients treated in a mobile dental facility.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: It is unlawful for any corporation to practice dentistry or dental hygiene or to hold itself out as entitled to engage therein.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: The board shall promulgate rules limiting the amount of Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed by licensees of the board.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any licensed dentist who employs or engages the services of a dental laboratory or dental laboratory technician or any other person, firm, or corporation to perform any of the operations or to fabricate any of the appliances or devices referred to in subsection (a) of this section shall furnish that person, firm, or corporation with a written work authorization

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A dental hygienist shall apply to the board for a certificate to administer local anesthetics. The board shall not issue a certificate until the applicant has met the requirements set forth by the board.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The person, firm, or corporation receiving a work authorization from a licensed dentist shall retain the original work authorization and the dentist shall retain a duplicate copy for a period of two (2) years.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: The board shall require proof of a current healthcare-provider-level basic life support certificate before issuing a certificate and a yearly renewal certificate to administer local anesthetics.
